records.text: Dan Flood's high-school friend said they attended middle and high school together, that Flood had worked in private security for at least 20 years, and that he last saw Flood providing security for a Dallas billionaire at the Cattlemen's Ball.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep NIEbqsLAK8g)

appearances.snippet: We know that for a fact because one of his high school buddies after the assassination posted this. Bro, the head of Charlie Kirk's security team, the guy they say is in on it was my friend as a kid. We grew up together. I went to middle and high school with Dan Flood. Matter of fact, last time I saw him. He was doing security for some Dallas billionaire at the Cattleman's Ball. What a crazy small world. Yeah, this dude has been in private security for at least 20 years. I had no idea he was running it for TPUSA.

verification.notes: The transcript quotes an unidentified social-media post, but the original post, author identity, and relationship to Dan Flood are not available for authentication. Live searches found no reliable independent source confirming all three details: shared middle/high school, 20 years in private security, and the Cattlemen's Ball encounter.
